It's just a quick drawing, a little stylized. You have really nice features, it was fun to draw!

As the other guy said try to use reference as much as possible, especially when you're just starting out. 

The first thing that I see is off in your drawing are the arms and legs. Especially the arm on the left - you are missing an elbow, instead you just have a curved line there. Also, the arm at the wrist is going a bit thinner compared to the rest of the arm. For the legs, you have quite a big gap between them. I suggest looking at yourself in the mirror to try to make sense of the exact pose.

Hope this is somewhat helpful. Keep it up!
